owner:ruling:2026-10-18.title: Owner pricing ruling: blessing prices, promotion price effect and Store prices
owner:ruling:2026-10-18.ruling: Owner pricing ruling 2026-10-18 (PR #2194). Five regular blessings: level <=30: 2000; 30<level<120: 2000+200*(level-30); level >=120: 20000+75*(level-120). Blood and Heart of the Mountain: level <=30: 2600; 30<level<120: 2600+260*(level-30); level >=120: 26000+100*(level-120). Twist of Fate: level <=30: 2000; 30<level<270: 2000+200*(level-30); level >=270: 50000. A promotion has no blessing price effect. Store prices in Tibia Coins: all seven 130; Twist of Fate 8; Blood and Heart of the Mountain 25 each; The Spark of the Phoenix 20; the four other regular blessings 15 each.
